{"action":"done", "summary": "Specification phase complete for Stage 2: Nested Savepoint Transactions for TinyDB.

**Artifacts created**:
- `specs/001-transactions/spec.md` — Full feature specification with 14 functional requirements (FR-001 through FR-014), 5 user stories, 10 success criteria, key entities, and assumptions. Stage 2 requirements (R09-R13) supersede Stage 1 R07 (nesting rejection).
- `specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md` — Quality checklist, all items passed on first review.

**Specification highlights**:
- Retains all Stage 1 requirements (R01-R06, R08) as FR-001 through FR-009
- Adds Stage 2 nested savepoint requirements (R09-R13) as FR-010 through FR-014
- 5 user scenarios: atomic write, automatic rollback, nested transactions with savepoints, persistence across close/reopen, plus edge cases
- 10 measurable success criteria covering zero writes during transaction, single write on commit, full rollback, 3+ nesting levels, inner rollback isolation, outer failure discarding, persistence, upstream test suite pass, non-transactional compatibility, and ID collision avoidance
- No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain
- No extension hooks configured

**Ready for**: `$speckit-plan` or `$speckit-tasks` phase."}
